name: Will a water softener improve my water pressure?

mainEntity.name: Will a water softener improve my water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A water softener is designed to remove hard minerals and does not directly increase water pressure. However, by preventing scale buildup in pipes and appliances, it can indirectly help maintain existing water pressure over time. Hard water deposits can restrict flow, so by softening your water, you avoid this common cause of decreased pressure. If you are experiencing low water pressure, a water softener may be part of the solution, but a general plumbing inspection is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: While not directly increasing pressure, a water softener prevents scale buildup in pipes, which can help maintain good water pressure over time.
